_comment: What `diff.ts --selftest` must report for actual-dirty.json — EXACTLY this set, no more and no less.
Hand-written, and that is the whole point: a manifest generated from the diff's own output would be a
gate built from its subject (docs/34-gate-independence.md) and could not fail. Each row is
`<category>: <subject>` as the report prints it, so a row that stops appearing names the arm that
broke. The self-check also asserts every one of the eight categories appears here at least once, so a
row silently lost from this file fails as missing COVERAGE rather than passing as a smaller set.
Adding a defect to actual-dirty.json without adding its row here fails as an EXTRA. That is intended:
the fixture and this file move together or the self-check says so.
